quote: Having just returned from the tour to Monte Cassino, the pictures in my head are still extremely vivid. Frank de Planta’s knowledge, description and narrative brought each location to life through his amazing passion for the subject. He made clear the sacrifice, by so many, all those years ago which we must not forget. A very emotional few days. Frank’s organisation and choice of accommodation was superb and the pleasant company from a mixed group was first class. I thoroughly recommend this to anyone with an interest in Cassino.
name: Mark Elgie
